sin.name: unused-page-size
sin.description: A function is handed how many rows to read, a limit, a page size or a listing, and never reads it: the caller believes the read is bounded while it reads every row, as the chat's catch-up read did when it ignored its listing's limit.
sin.rule: A page size handed to a function bounds the read it makes. Pass it on to the query, or remove the parameter and its callers' argument if the read is meant to be whole, and then name the read as whole.
